conv.table dream: CREATE TABLE dream(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id = 1),day TEXT,last_run_at TEXT)
conv.table friend: CREATE TABLE friend(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id = 1),paused_until INTEGER,disclosed_at TEXT)
conv.table group_remind_noted: CREATE TABLE group_remind_noted(member TEXT PRIMARY KEY,at INTEGER NOT NULL)
conv.table held_posts: CREATE TABLE held_posts(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,text TEXT NOT NULL,why TEXT NOT NULL,at INTEGER)
conv.table hold: CREATE TABLE hold(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id = 1),day TEXT NOT NULL,posted INTEGER NOT NULL)
conv.table items: CREATE TABLE items(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'task' CHECK(kind IN('task','i_owe','owed_to_me')),title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(title)BETWEEN 1 AND 300),details TEXT,due TEXT CHECK(due IS NULL OR due GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]*'),due_zone TEXT,remind_at INTEGER,repeat TEXT,person TEXT,assignee TEXT,status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK(status IN('suggested','open','done','dropped','snoozed')),snooze_until INTEGER,origin TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'owner' CHECK(origin IN('owner','member','friend','inferred')),source_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'message' CHECK(source_kind IN('message','mail','meeting','import','other')),source_ref TEXT,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,done_at INTEGER,urgent INTEGER CHECK(urgent IS NULL OR urgent IN(0,1)))
conv.table learned_batches: CREATE TABLE learned_batches(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,at INTEGER NOT NULL,msg_ts INTEGER)
conv.table learned_changes: CREATE TABLE learned_changes(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,at INTEGER NOT NULL,source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN('dream','look')),action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN('add','update','merge','delete','undone')),file TEXT NOT NULL,gist TEXT NOT NULL,merged TEXT,batch INTEGER,outcome TEXT CHECK(outcome IS NULL OR outcome IN('confirmed','undone','gone')))
conv.table meeting_calls: CREATE TABLE meeting_calls(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id = 1),at INTEGER NOT NULL,count INTEGER NOT NULL)
conv.table meetings: CREATE TABLE meetings(event_id TEXT NOT NULL,start_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,end_ms INTEGER,title TEXT NOT NULL,attendees TEXT NOT NULL,link TEXT,all_day INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(all_day IN(0,1)),response TEXT,private INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(private IN(0,1)),noted INTEGER NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN('pending','claimed','sent','retry','failed','skipped')),why TEXT,tries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,at INTEGER,cost_usd REAL,PRIMARY KEY(event_id,start_ms))
conv.table quiet: CREATE TABLE quiet(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id = 1),until TEXT NOT NULL)
conv.table reminders: CREATE TABLE reminders(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id),key TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('held','claimed','sent','retry','folded')),fire_at INTEGER NOT NULL,at INTEGER NOT NULL,late INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,tries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,ts INTEGER,UNIQUE(item_id,key))
conv.table reset: CREATE TABLE reset(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id = 1),at TEXT NOT NULL)
conv.table routine_runs: CREATE TABLE routine_runs(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,since INTEGER NOT NULL,period TEXT,status TEXT CHECK(status IS NULL OR status IN('started','delivered','failed','skipped')),at INTEGER,attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,told INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,last_delivered INTEGER)
conv.table seen_mail: CREATE TABLE seen_mail(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)
conv.table session: CREATE TABLE session(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id = 1),session_id TEXT,cost_usd REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,last_turn_at TEXT,last_context_tokens INTEGER,compact_failed_at TEXT,base_tokens INTEGER,seen_at TEXT,untrusted_in TEXT)
conv.table task_events: CREATE TABLE task_events(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id),at INTEGER NOT NULL,by TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN('added','edited','done','reopened','dropped','snoozed','suggested','confirmed','rejected','reminded')),before TEXT,after TEXT)
conv.table voice_notes: CREATE TABLE voice_notes(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,ts INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,id TEXT NOT NULL,size INTEGER NOT NULL,by TEXT NOT NULL,by_name TEXT,snippet TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT,name TEXT,seconds REAL)
conv.table voice_quotes: CREATE TABLE voice_quotes(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,message_ts INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,quoted_ts INTEGER NOT NULL)
conv.trigger items_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER items_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON items BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'tasks are never deleted: drop them'); END
conv.trigger task_events_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER task_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON task_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'the task history is append-only'); END
conv.trigger task_events_no_update: CREATE TRIGGER task_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON task_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'the task history is append-only'); END

instance.table intake: CREATE TABLE intake(tenant TEXT NOT NULL,purpose TEXT NOT NULL,done_at TEXT,stored TEXT,problem_at TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(tenant,purpose))
instance.table kv: CREATE TABLE kv(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
instance.table looks: CREATE TABLE looks(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,at TEXT NOT NULL,at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'owner',night INTEGER NOT NULL,message INTEGER NOT NULL,sent INTEGER,next_check_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,cost_usd REAL NOT NULL,tool_calls INTEGER NOT NULL,archived INTEGER NOT NULL,delegations INTEGER NOT NULL,outcome TEXT NOT NULL)
instance.table notices: CREATE TABLE notices(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,last_at INTEGER)
instance.table payments: CREATE TABLE payments(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,id TEXT NOT NULL,ts TEXT NOT NULL,merchant TEXT NOT NULL,total_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,last4 TEXT NOT NULL,cart_hash TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL)
instance.table spend: CREATE TABLE spend(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,at INTEGER NOT NULL,day TEXT NOT NULL,conv TEXT NOT NULL,payer TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(payer IN('login','key')),kind TEXT NOT NULL,usd REAL NOT NULL CHECK(usd > 0))
instance.view payments_latest: CREATE VIEW payments_latest AS SELECT p.*,g.first_ts AS first_ts,g.first_seq AS first_seq FROM payments p JOIN(SELECT id,MIN(ts)AS first_ts,MIN(seq)AS first_seq FROM payments GROUP BY id)g ON g.id = p.id WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payments q WHERE q.id = p.id AND(q.ts > p.ts OR(q.ts = p.ts AND q.seq > p.seq)))
